palette.board: dark olive-green chalkboard #484828..#485828 ~36% at final framing

content: Original: a prehistoric-style classroom — large wood-framed chalkboard upper-centre, two small hand-drawn wall posters left and right (original images/words), rows of small wooden desks with stools in the foreground, a stone lectern at right with an original teacher character standing behind it (head and shoulders visible; any original design, e.g. a bald elder with a long white moustache). On the board, chalk-white CURSIVE (joined script) text "topic: sabre cat" spanning ~60% of the board width, placed so it stays fully in frame at the final framing (left end at least 80 px from the frame edge after the zoom).
timeline: f0: hard cut to the WIDE classroom (board + posters + desks + lectern + teacher all visible).

f8-58: CAMERA PUSH-IN = pure zoom about the FIXED SCREEN POINT (960, 50) (top-centre of the frame, on the board). NO pan: the screen point (960,50) shows the same canvas point in every frame. Scale (content size relative to f0) per frame must follow camera_scale_table (interpolate odd frames linearly).

f59-178: after the push, a very slow continued creep-in: continued slow creep exactly per camera_scale_table (same fixed point). The teacher lifts a thin stick pointer and taps/points at the text: pointer changes position in several discrete steps (pose swaps, 1-2 frames each) 3-5 times; mouth open/closed swaps allowed.

style.line: thick near-black (#080808..#202020) hand-drawn outlines, slightly uneven width 4-7px at 1080p; flat fills, at most a light hand-shaded texture; no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows
style.typography: handwritten / marker-style lowercase labels (font UNKNOWN in source; use any handwritten-looking font or draw strokes); never a geometric sans
style.originality: ALL characters, creatures, wording and objects must be NEW and original as specified here; do not imitate any existing show
